name: Rasa resource: examples/shop-assistant

RASA_PRO_LICENSE.description: Required. Full Rasa Developer Edition license

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Required. OpenAI project key used for this resource's model calls

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Required. BotFather token for the private Telegram shop bot

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRETS_JSON.description: Required. Complete Google Desktop OAuth client JSON for one-time Sheets consent

GOOGLE_TOKEN_JSON.description: Optional. Authorized-user JSON produced by the Sheets consent command

SHOP_SHEET_ID.description: Required. Identifier of the dedicated blank demo spreadsheet

SHOP_OPERATOR_CHAT_ID.description: Required. Positive private Telegram chat ID used by the demo operator

postCreateCommand: bash "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.devcontainer/resource-base/ready.sh" examples/shop-assistant "test -x .venv/bin/python && test -x server/.venv/bin/python && test -x consent/.venv/bin/python"
